MASTER CARDHOLDER REGISTRY, CATEGORY-WISE RATION CARD ALLOCATION, BENEFICIARY ADDITION/DELETION AUDIT, AND IDENTITY VERIFICATION LOGS
SUBJECT: Circle-Wise Breakdown of APL, BPL, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), and Annapurna Ration Card Distribution in East and North-East Districts, Sample Household Registry Extract for Sundar Nagari, Bogus Card Elimination Drive, and Monthly Income Verification Protocols.

1. STATUTORY CATEGORIZATION OF RATION CARDS

1.1 Under the Delhi Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS) guidelines, ration cards are issued under four distinct categories based on household income criteria:
a) Above Poverty Line (APL): Households with annual income exceeding ₹ 24,200/-.
b) Below Poverty Line (BPL): Households with annual income below ₹ 24,200/- (entitled to 35 kg foodgrains at subsidized prices).
c) Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY): Poorest of the poor families, destitute households, widow-headed families (entitled to 35 kg foodgrains per month at heavily subsidized rates: ₹ 2/kg wheat, ₹ 3/kg rice).
d) Annapurna Scheme: Indigent senior citizens aged 65 or above without family support (entitled to 10 kg free foodgrains).
